context: User's draft sketch has an outraged interviewer line and a resolved ending that both break the deadpan mechanic; agent must fix both.

checklist.name: flattens_interviewer_line
checklist.description: The outraged/emotional interviewer line is rewritten to be flat and reasonable-sounding, with no exclamation or overt emotion.

checklist.name: keeps_ending_unresolved
checklist.description: The ending no longer has the spokesperson concede or reverse the decision; the absurd position is maintained calmly.

checklist.name: gradual_escalation_preserved
checklist.description: The rewritten exchange escalates in incremental steps rather than jumping straight between extremes.

checklist.name: contradiction_via_question
checklist.description: The contradiction is exposed via the interviewer's follow-up questions rather than direct narration or a stated 'that doesn't make sense'.

checklist.name: explains_the_fix
checklist.description: Agent briefly explains, in its own words, why flattening the interviewer and leaving the ending unresolved improves the sketch.
